notes: 40 whole-testis profiles, P10/P12/P14/P16/P18 each WT4/SetxKO4 by source titles. Archive has 40 genome RSEM tables plus 40 piRNA tables. Genome tables retain estimated expected_count, effective_length and TPM; 4.6-5.9% noninteger expected counts. Only TPM sensitivity fitted here. Matched original histology, animal independence and detailed allele provenance remain unresolved.
P12/P14 total-RNA WT2/null2, plus m6A-IP libraries that must not increase total-RNA replication. Processed files described as DESeq2 differential results; sample-level raw counts not established.

Whole testis at P8/P9/P10; gene counts available but mainly earlier than target age. P8 three WT/mutant littermate pairs, P9 three pairs include a HET control, P10 two HET/mutant pairs from one litter. Respect paired litter structure, mixed controls and small P10 group.

RNA-seq and Ribo-seq, P8/P10 knockout and adult WLA alleles; GEO 30 samples are not 30 independent bulk RNA libraries. Available series supplements are differential/translation spreadsheets. Individual raw gene counts not established.

Whole-testis P14/P16 cKO3 each. P14 control2 plus Cre-control2, P16 control2 plus Cre-control4; controls cannot be pooled silently. Processed files explicitly DESeq2-normalized counts, not raw counts.

Six source libraries, control3/Eef1g-cKO3, FACS L/Z at P12. FeatureCounts integer columns verified separately from annotation. Sorted population is not whole testis; exact animal/pooling independence and L/Z mix not established from source metadata. Never added to primary whole-testis votes.
Purified A4 and L/Z, RNA-seq plus H3K4me3 ChIP-seq and NOMe-seq; 20 series entries cannot be counted as 20 bulk expression samples. Kallisto estimates and stage/source units require separate review.

P12 Tardbp/TDP43 whole testis WT3/cKO3; WT all batch2, KO two batch1 and one batch2. Salmon/tximport bias-corrected estimated gene counts, not automatically raw integer counts; treatment-plus-batch effect depends on one KO in the overlapping batch. Matrix not downloaded or fitted here.
Despite the CFP1 meiotic-progression title, this series is P21 spermatocyte ChIP-seq, including H3K4me3/CFP1 and input. Not a six-sample RNA-seq contrast.

P14 WT4/mutant4 whole-testis entries, adult 2N/4N profiles, single-cell and iCLIP in one series. Bulk spreadsheets explicitly contain DESeq2-normalized counts/results. Neither all 25 entries nor all knock-in alleles are exchangeable knockout RNA replicates.

P12 total testis Ythdc2-null3/HET3; P8 smaller mixed WT/HET controls, plus ovary, m6A and in-vitro binding assays. Processed total-RNA files described as DESeq2 transcript-abundance comparisons; units not established by filename. Not downloaded or admitted as raw counts.

CLIP/PAR-CLIP/RIP/m6A study includes HeLa and mouse seminiferous tubules, mostly two source repeats. P8.5 input RNA is not an independent three-per-group whole-testis cohort. Supplements are binding/enrichment spreadsheets.
